page.overview:
What is Buzz Lightyear of Star Command: The Adventure Begins?

Buzz Lightyear of Star Command: The Adventure Begins (also referred to as Buzz Lightyear of Star Command) is a 2000 direct-to-video animated film produced by and Pixar Animation Studios that served as a spin-off of the Toy Story franchise and led to the television series Buzz Lightyear of Star Command. The film has aired on ABC Family.

Although Pixar was involved in the production of the movie and TV show, they only created the opening scene with the toys in Andy's room, as well as the theme song for the TV series while the rest were traditionally animated by WDTA.

Canonically, this is considered to be the show that exists within the fictional universe of the Toy Story films and inspired the existence of the Buzz Lightyear toyline.

Tim Allen reprises his role as the voice of Buzz Lightyear for this film; however, Tom Hanks does not provide his voice for Woody, who is voiced by his brother Jim Hanks instead. Additionally, John Ratzenberger does not lend his voice to Hamm; he is voiced by Andrew Stanton instead.
